summary: GridAI Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K under Items 1.01 and 3.02 regarding a private placement securities purchase agreement entered on July 1, 2026. The company agreed to sell 664,598 common shares, 1,187,325 pre-funded warrants (exercise price $0.0001), and 1,851,923 common warrants (exercise price $4.47) at a combined price of $4.59 per unit, for gross proceeds of $8.5 million. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and working capital. Closing is July 7, 2026, with 5% due at close and 95% upon SEC registration effectiveness. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
